reports.title: Fiji Bureau of Statistics
reports.description: Fiji's national statistical office, established under the Statistics Act and Census Act, responsible for compiling and publishing the country's official economic and social statistics.

reports.title: Consumer Price Index (CPI)
reports.description: Monthly official consumer price index tracking changes in the prices of a basket of goods and services in Fiji; the index weights are derived from the Household Income and Expenditure Survey.

reports.title: Fiji Gross Domestic Product (GDP) / National Accounts
reports.description: Official annual estimates of Fiji's gross domestic product (production, expenditure and income approaches), compiled following the 2008 System of National Accounts.

reports.title: Household Income and Expenditure Survey (HIES)
reports.description: Nationwide household survey conducted every five years by the Fiji Bureau of Statistics; used to update CPI weights, the poverty rate, and inputs to the national accounts.

reports.title: National Statistical Office of Papua New Guinea
reports.description: Papua New Guinea's national statistical office, established under the Statistical Services Act 1980, responsible for producing and coordinating official statistics across government.

reports.title: Solomon Islands National Statistics Office
reports.description: Solomon Islands' national statistical office, operating under the Statistics Act 1970 and Census Act 1959, responsible for compiling official economic and social statistics.

reports.title: Vanuatu Bureau of Statistics
reports.description: Vanuatu's national statistical office (formerly named the Vanuatu National Statistics Office, VNSO), responsible for CPI, national accounts, trade and census statistics.

reports.title: Samoa Bureau of Statistics
reports.description: Samoa's national statistical office, responsible for compiling and disseminating official economic and social statistics and for hosting Samoa's IMF e-GDDS National Summary Data Page.

reports.title: Tonga Statistics Department
reports.description: Tonga's national statistical office, responsible for producing official economic and social statistics including the census, CPI and national accounts.

reports.title: Kiribati National Statistics Office
reports.description: Kiribati's national statistical office, established under the Statistics Act 1997, responsible for producing official statistics including CPI, GDP and trade data.

reports.title: Nauru Bureau of Statistics
reports.description: Nauru's national statistical office, sitting within the Ministry of Finance, responsible for producing the country's Consumer Price Index and other official statistics.

reports.title: Tuvalu Central Statistics Division
reports.description: Tuvalu's official statistical agency, governed by the Statistics Act 1978, responsible for national accounts, census and other official statistics.

reports.title: Pacific Community (SPC) — Statistics for Development Division
reports.description: One of SPC's technical divisions, based in Noumea and Suva, that strengthens the capacity of Pacific Island countries' national statistical systems through technical assistance, training workshops and staff attachments covering national accounts, CPI, censuses and other official statistics.

reports.title: Pacific Financial Technical Assistance Centre (PFTAC)
reports.description: IMF regional technical assistance centre established in 1993, a collaborative venture between the IMF, member countries and donor partners, providing capacity-development support on macroeconomic and financial statistics and policy to sixteen Pacific Island countries.

dependencies.basis: Fiji Bureau of Statistics' own GDP rebase release states the SNA edition its national accounts compilation follows, ending with a verbatim quote: {"The compilation of GDP continues to follow the United Nations System of National Accounts 2008 (2008 SNA)"}.

Fiji's CPI release states its weighting basket is sourced directly from the HIES, ending with a verbatim quote: {"The CPI weights are derived from the Household Income and Expenditure Survey [HIES] of 2019/2020"}.

Fiji Bureau of Statistics' own HIES landing page names national accounts development as one of the survey's direct uses, ending with a verbatim quote: {"contributes ... to the development of the national accounts"}.

The Reserve Bank of Fiji's own press release names Fiji Bureau of Statistics as a joint host, alongside RBF and the Ministry of Economy, of the IMF mission that built Fiji's e-GDDS National Summary Data Page, ending with a verbatim quote: {"The mission supported the development of the National Summary Data Page (NSDP) – a national 'data hub' that features data dissemination in Statistical Data and Metadata eXchange (SDMX) machine readable format as well as human readable format"}.

Samoa Bureau of Statistics' own National Summary Data Page states Samoa's participation in the IMF's e-GDDS framework by name, ending with a verbatim quote: {"the enhanced General Data Dissemination System in which Samoa participates"}.
dependencies.evidence_quote: the enhanced General Data Dissemination System in which Samoa participates

dependencies.basis: An IMF/PFTAC technical assistance report documents Vanuatu's own statistics office directly requesting and hosting a PFTAC mission, ending with a verbatim quote: {"The Vanuatu National Statistics Office (VNSO) requested a mission by the IMF's Pacific Financial Technical Assistance Centre (PFTAC) for conducting a feasibility study on the implementation of a quarterly national accounts (QNA) in Vanuatu"}.

PNG's National Statistical Office lists SPC's Statistics for Development Division by name among its partners/external resources, linking to its own country page, ending with a verbatim quote: {"Statistics for Development (SPC)"}.

Solomon Islands National Statistics Office's own about-us page names SPC's Statistics for Development Division specifically under its Pacific Community partnership links, ending with a verbatim quote: {"SPC Statistics for Development Division"}.
Kiribati NSO's own about-us page names the Statistics for Development Division specifically under regional websites, ending with a verbatim quote: {"Statistics for Development Division (SDD)"}.

Tonga Statistics Department's own news article on its statistical capacity-building program names SPC's role, ending with a verbatim quote: {"The Pacific Community (SPC) strengthened regional data capability"}.

_dropped.why: [Grok carryover] Grok's evidence was SPC SDD's own generic homepage text ("technical support ... across Pacific Island countries"), which never names Fiji specifically. Checked Fiji Bureau of Statistics' own homepage and about-us page directly (both live-fetched) — neither mentions SPC or SDD, despite SDD maintaining a Suva office. No FBOS document ties the two, so not minted.

[Grok carryover] Grok's evidence was PFTAC's own homepage generic mission text, not Fiji-specific. PFTAC's About page does list Fiji by name among its 13 IMF-member countries served, but that's a country-level membership list, not a document tying it to Fiji Bureau of Statistics specifically — unlike the Vanuatu case (a named VNSO-requested mission), which was minted instead.

Samoa Bureau of Statistics' homepage footer links to "Secretariat of the Pacific Community" and PFTAC generically under "Other Links," but never names the Statistics for Development Division specifically or describes a support relationship — same generic-pointer problem as Grok's original claim, so not minted (contrast with PNG/Solomon Islands/Kiribati, which name SDD explicitly).

IMF press release PR19/131 ("Vanuatu Implements the IMF's Enhanced General Data Dissemination System") would not render body text via fetch (JS-only shell). The IMF DSBB NSDP page for Vanuatu that was reachable turned out to contain an unfilled template placeholder — it literally reads "the enhanced General Data Dissemination System in which Country participates" rather than naming Vanuatu — so it does not actually verify the claim. Not minted; a real e-GDDS launch likely exists but no live, readable, country-specific document could be confirmed.

Nauru Bureau of Statistics' site links to spc.int generally and to SPC's PopGIS mapping tool, but never names the Statistics for Development Division specifically or describes a support relationship. Matches the brief's expectation that Nauru would yield very little beyond a bare institutional presence.

Tuvalu Central Statistics Division's about-us page links generically to spc.int, pftac.org, and imf.org as external resources with no descriptive text tying any of them to a specific support/membership relationship. Matches the brief's expectation that Tuvalu would yield very little beyond a bare institutional presence.

Kiribati NSO's economy page lists CPI, GDP, GFS, trade, tourism, BOP and IIP releases, but none of the pages checked name a specific SNA edition, COICOP version, or BPM6 for Kiribati's compilation — no edition-specific methodology edge could be built, and individual per-release nodes were judged not worth minting at this depth for a lowest-priority batch given the institutional node and SPC edge already capture the verifiable relationship.

Solomon Islands CPI release pages give no base year or COICOP edition; a generic classification would be used but no document names which edition, so neither COICOP node was wired per the edition-matching rule.

PNG NSO's GDP page (nso.gov.pg/statistics/economy/gross-domestic-products/) presents current/constant price series for 2013-2019 but does not name which SNA edition underlies the compilation anywhere on the page checked; per the honesty rule this was left unminted rather than guessed.
